# ── Read one investment's SharePoint folder (and its subfolders) and pull the facts out of each document ──
import re

SP = "m365-sharepoint"
# File types the SharePoint connector can read as text.
READABLE = {"docx", "docm", "xlsx", "xlsm", "pptx", "pptm", "pdf", "doc", "xls", "ppt", "rtf", "odt", "ods", "odp",
            "txt", "csv", "tsv", "md", "htm", "html"}
MAX_READ = 50
MAX_DEPTH = 8
MAX_ITEMS = 1500
# Characters of each file sent to AI (the AI step's cap is 32,000 including the prompt).
MAX_TEXT = 12000
# The second, figures-only pass sends less, so the model has room to finish its answer.
SLIM_TEXT = 6000
# Source-document groups, with the words that identify each. The file's own name is matched first, then the
# folders above it, so a capital account statement filed under "Capital Calls" is still a valuation.
CATEGORIES = [
    ("Capital calls", ["capital call", "drawdown", "draw down", "call notice"]),
    ("Valuations", ["capital account", "valuation", "wealth statement", "unit statement", "statement of account"]),
    ("Due diligence", ["due diligence", "/dd/", "ic memo", "memorandum", "teaser", "credentials", "red flags"]),
    ("Terms and deeds", ["application", "subscription", "deed", "agreement", "declaration", "questionnaire",
                         "fatca"]),
    ("Tax statements", ["tax"]),
    ("Dividend statements", ["dividend", "distribution", "payment advice"]),
    ("Annual reports", ["annual report", "annual", "financial statement", "financial report", "accounts"]),
    ("Investor updates", ["update", "newsletter", "quarterly", "investor", "shareholder", "report", "presentation"]),
    ("Correspondence", ["correspondence", "letter", "email", "notice", "minutes", "certificate", "media release",
                        "ruling"]),
]
DOC_TYPES = {
    "tax statement": "Tax statements",
    "dividend statement": "Dividend statements",
    "distribution statement": "Dividend statements",
    "capital call": "Capital calls",
    "capital account statement": "Valuations",
    "valuation": "Valuations",
    "annual report": "Annual reports",
    "investor update": "Investor updates",
    "correspondence": "Correspondence",
    "investment agreement": "Terms and deeds",
    "due diligence": "Due diligence",
}
# Read the documents most likely to hold the investment's terms first, then the money in, then the money back
READ_ORDER = ["Terms and deeds", "Capital calls", "Valuations", "Dividend statements", "Annual reports",
              "Investor updates", "Tax statements", "Due diligence", "Correspondence", "Other documents"]

# Folder names that are drawers of documents inside one investment, rather than investments in their own right.
DRAWER_WORDS = ["capital call", "drawdown", "draw down", "quarterly", "annual", "report", "statement", "tax",
                "dividend", "distribution", "application", "subscription", "deed", "agreement", "due diligence",
                "correspondence", "letter", "email", "notice", "minutes", "certificate", "valuation", "update",
                "newsletter", "legal", "admin", "signed", "scan"]
DRAWER_NAMES = ["dd", "ic", "docs", "misc", "other"]
# How far below a link that names no investment to look for separate ones, and how many folders to open doing it.
FIND_DEPTH = 3
FIND_OPENS = 40

PROMPT = (
    "This is one document from a family's records about a single private investment: either shares in a company "
    "or an interest in a fund, trust or limited partnership. Pull out only what this document states; put null or "
    "[] when it doesn't say, and never estimate. Money is a plain number in dollars (no $ or commas). Dates are "
    "YYYY-MM-DD. "
    "doc_type is one of: tax statement, dividend statement, distribution statement, capital call, capital "
    "account statement, annual report, investor update, correspondence, investment agreement, due diligence, "
    "valuation, other. company is the company or fund invested in; holder is the entity that owns the shares or "
    "units. new_investment is ONLY when this document records money being invested (a subscription, purchase, "
    "capital call or drawdown notice): its date and the amount called or paid. dividends lists ONLY payments "
    "this document itself pays or advises (a dividend or distribution statement or payment advice): payment "
    "date, cash amount and franked percentage (100 for fully franked). dividend_year_totals is for documents "
    "that total a year's dividends or distributions instead (tax statements): year_ending and amount. valuation "
    "is the value this document puts on THIS HOLDER's own holding (a directors' valuation, their capital account "
    "balance, or unit price times units held), with its date and basis in a few words. "
    "scope says whose money the figures are. Say \"investor\" only when the amounts are this holder's own: the "
    "call they were asked to pay, the payment they received, their capital account. Say \"fund\" when the amounts "
    "describe the whole fund or company instead: total fund size, net assets, portfolio investments the fund "
    "made, amounts paid to all investors, unit prices or percentages. A quarterly report, investor update or due "
    "diligence paper is almost always \"fund\". When scope is \"fund\", leave new_investment, dividends, "
    "dividend_year_totals and valuation null or empty, however clearly the document states those figures. "
    "capital_account is only for a capital account or wealth statement that totals this holder's position: its "
    "date, and inception to date the commitment, unfunded commitment, contributions paid in, distributions paid "
    "out and the ending capital or net asset value. "
    "sector is what the business does and where, at most five words, in the shape \"Cold-chain logistics, NSW\". "
    "asset_type is what kind of holding this is in a word or two: equity, fund, fund manager, property, loan. "
    "tax_status is the tax structure the documents name for the investment itself - ESVCLP, VCLP, MIT, AMIT, "
    "unit trust, company - and null when no document says. liquidity is how the holder can get their money out "
    "if a document says so (for example \"redeemable quarterly\", \"locked until wind-up\", \"no redemptions\"), "
    "otherwise null. Never guess any of these three. "
    "website is the company or fund's own site, never its administrator's, registry's or lawyer's. "
    "milestones are up to 3 dated events for the "
    "company or the investment (expansions, new sites, funding rounds, first dividend). business, investment and "
    "rationale are short plain sentences (at most 40 words each): what the company does, what the holding is, "
    "and why it was bought, only if this document says so. "
    "Answer with the JSON object only, and no explanation."
)
# When the model runs out of room to answer - long quarterly reports make it think, and the answer is cut
# off mid-JSON - ask again for the figures alone. Losing a wealth statement costs more than losing prose.
SLIM_PROMPT = (
    "This is one document from a family's records about a single private investment. Pull out only the "
    "figures it states; put null or [] when it doesn't say, and never estimate. Money is a plain number in "
    "dollars (no $ or commas). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. scope is \"investor\" when the amounts are this "
    "holder's own and \"fund\" when they describe the whole fund; when it is \"fund\", leave "
    "new_investment, dividends, dividend_year_totals and valuation empty. business is one short sentence "
    "on what the company or fund does, and sector is at most five words in the shape \"Cold-chain "
    "logistics, NSW\", both only if this document says. "
    "Answer with the JSON object only, and no explanation."
)
SLIM_SHAPE = (
    '{"doc_type": str, "doc_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"|null, "company": str|null, "holder": str|null, '
    '"new_investment": {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "amount": number}|null, '
    '"dividends": [{"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "amount": number, "franked_pct": number|null}], '
    '"dividend_year_totals": [{"year_ending": "YYYY-MM-DD", "amount": number}], '
    '"valuation": {"amount": number, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "basis": str}|null, '
    '"scope": "investor|fund", "business": str|null, "sector": str|null, '
    '"capital_account": {"as_at": "YYYY-MM-DD", "commitment": number|null, "unfunded": number|null, '
    '"contributions": number|null, "distributions": number|null, "nav": number|null}|null}'
)
SHAPE = (
    '{"doc_type": str, "doc_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"|null, "company": str|null, "holder": str|null, '
    '"instrument": str|null, "shares": number|null, "price_per_share": number|null, "ownership_pct": number|null, '
    '"new_investment": {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "amount": number}|null, '
    '"dividends": [{"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "amount": number, "franked_pct": number|null}], '
    '"dividend_year_totals": [{"year_ending": "YYYY-MM-DD", "amount": number}], '
    '"valuation": {"amount": number, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "basis": str}|null, '
    '"milestones": [{"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "text": str}], "website": str|null, "board": str|null, '
    '"asset_type": str|null, "tax_status": str|null, "liquidity": str|null, "sector": str|null, '
    '"scope": "investor|fund", '
    '"capital_account": {"as_at": "YYYY-MM-DD", "commitment": number|null, "unfunded": number|null, '
    '"contributions": number|null, "distributions": number|null, "nav": number|null}|null, '
    '"status": "active|exited|written off|unknown", "business": str|null, "investment": str|null, '
    '"rationale": str|null}'
)


def _ext(name):
    m = re.search(r"\.([A-Za-z0-9]+)$", str(name or ""))
    return m.group(1).lower() if m else ""


def _err(exc):
    msg = str(exc)
    if msg.startswith("tool_error: "):
        msg = msg[len("tool_error: "):]
    if "no usable credential" in msg or "credential unavailable" in msg:
        return "the SharePoint connection needs connecting (Settings → Connections → m365-sharepoint)"
    return msg[:300]


def _num(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool) or v is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return float(v)
    s = re.sub(r"[,$\s]", "", str(v))
    neg = s.startswith("(") and s.endswith(")")
    try:
        n = float(s.strip("()"))
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return -n if neg else n


def _date(v):
    s = str(v or "")[:10]
    return s if re.match(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", s) else ""


def _text(v, limit=400):
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(v or "")).strip()
    return s[:limit] if s and s.lower() not in ("null", "none", "n/a") else ""


def _category(name, parent):
    """The group a file belongs to: its own name decides, then the folders above it."""
    for text in (name.lower(), "/" + parent.lower() + "/"):
        for label, words in CATEGORIES:
            if any(w in text for w in words):
                return label
    return "Other documents"


def _year(name, modified):
    """The year a file is about: FY24 / 2024 in its name, else the year it was last changed."""
    m = re.search(r"\bFY ?(\d{4}|\d{2})\b", name, re.I)
    if m:
        y = int(m.group(1))
        return {"year": y + 2000 if y < 100 else y, "fy": True}
    m = re.search(r"(?<!\d)((?:19|20)\d{2})(?!\d)", name)
    if m:
        return {"year": int(m.group(1)), "fy": False}
    d = _date(modified)
    return {"year": int(d[:4]) if d else None, "fy": False}


def _list(args):
    out = []
    folder = {}
    cursor = None
    while True:
        page = api.connectors.invoke(server=SP, tool="list_sharepoint_folder",
                                     args={"cursor": cursor} if cursor else dict(args, page_size=200))
        if not isinstance(page, dict):
            raise ValueError("SharePoint sent back something unexpected")
        if not cursor:
            folder = page.get("folder") or {}
        out.extend(page.get("items") or [])
        cursor = page.get("nextCursor")
        if not cursor or len(out) >= MAX_ITEMS:
            return folder, out


def _is_drawer(name):
    low = str(name or "").strip().lower()
    if low in DRAWER_NAMES:
        return True
    for w in DRAWER_WORDS:
        if w in low:
            return True
    return False


def _is_investment(f):
    """Its own investment when it is not a drawer and either names an amount or holds drawers of its own."""
    name = str(f.get("name") or "")
    if _is_drawer(name):
        return False
    if re.search(r"\$\s?\d", name):
        return True
    _, kids = _list({"drive_id": f.get("driveId"), "item_id": f.get("id")})
    for k in kids:
        if k.get("isFolder") and _is_drawer(str(k.get("name") or "")):
            return True
    return False


def _clean(raw):
    d = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
    inv = d.get("new_investment")
    inv = inv if isinstance(inv, dict) else {}
    val = d.get("valuation")
    val = val if isinstance(val, dict) else {}
    acct = d.get("capital_account")
    acct = acct if isinstance(acct, dict) else {}
    out = {
        "doc_type": _text(d.get("doc_type"), 40).lower(),
        "doc_date": _date(d.get("doc_date")),
        "company": _text(d.get("company"), 120),
        "holder": _text(d.get("holder"), 120),
        "instrument": _text(d.get("instrument"), 80),
        "shares": _num(d.get("shares")),
        "price_per_share": _num(d.get("price_per_share")),
        "ownership_pct": _num(d.get("ownership_pct")),
        "new_investment": None,
        "valuation": None,
        "dividends": [],
        "dividend_year_totals": [],
        "milestones": [],
        "website": _text(d.get("website"), 120),
        "board": _text(d.get("board"), 120),
        "asset_type": _text(d.get("asset_type"), 40),
        "sector": _text(d.get("sector"), 50),
        "tax_status": _text(d.get("tax_status"), 40),
        "liquidity": _text(d.get("liquidity"), 110),
        "status": _text(d.get("status"), 20).lower(),
        "scope": "fund" if _text(d.get("scope"), 20).lower() == "fund" else "investor",
        "capital_account": None,
        "business": _text(d.get("business")),
        "investment": _text(d.get("investment")),
        "rationale": _text(d.get("rationale")),
    }
    amount = _num(inv.get("amount"))
    if _date(inv.get("date")) and amount:
        out["new_investment"] = {"date": _date(inv.get("date")), "amount": abs(amount)}
    amount = _num(val.get("amount"))
    if _date(val.get("date")) and amount:
        out["valuation"] = {"date": _date(val.get("date")), "amount": amount, "basis": _text(val.get("basis"), 80)}
    for x in d.get("dividends") or []:
        amount = _num(x.get("amount")) if isinstance(x, dict) else None
        if isinstance(x, dict) and _date(x.get("date")) and amount:
            out["dividends"].append({"date": _date(x.get("date")), "amount": abs(amount),
                                     "franked_pct": _num(x.get("franked_pct"))})
    for x in d.get("dividend_year_totals") or []:
        amount = _num(x.get("amount")) if isinstance(x, dict) else None
        if isinstance(x, dict) and _date(x.get("year_ending")) and amount is not None:
            out["dividend_year_totals"].append({"year_ending": _date(x.get("year_ending")), "amount": abs(amount)})
    if _date(acct.get("as_at")):
        totals = {k: _num(acct.get(k)) for k in ("commitment", "unfunded", "contributions", "distributions", "nav")}
        if any(v is not None for v in totals.values()):
            out["capital_account"] = dict(totals, as_at=_date(acct.get("as_at")))
    for x in (d.get("milestones") or [])[:3]:
        if isinstance(x, dict) and _date(x.get("date")) and _text(x.get("text")):
            out["milestones"].append({"date": _date(x.get("date")), "text": _text(x.get("text"), 120)})
    return out


link = str(params.get("folder_link") or "").strip()
pick = str(params.get("investment_name") or "").strip().lower()
docs = []
files = []
folder_name = ""
folder_url = ""
problem = ""

if not link:
    problem = "No folder link: paste the investment folder's SharePoint link (Share → Copy link) when you click Run now."
else:
    try:
        top, items = _list({"url": link})
        folder_name = str(top.get("name") or "")
        folder_url = str(top.get("webUrl") or link)
        # A link to the folder of all investments ("Shares") plus an investment name: open that investment's
        # folder wherever it sits below the link. The shallowest match wins, so wrapper folders are stepped past.
        if pick:
            search = [(i, 1) for i in items if i.get("isFolder")]
            seen_folders = []
            found = False
            while search:
                cand, level = search.pop(0)
                cand_name = str(cand.get("name") or "")
                if pick in cand_name.lower():
                    folder_name = cand_name
                    folder_url = str(cand.get("webUrl") or folder_url)
                    _, items = _list({"drive_id": cand.get("driveId"), "item_id": cand.get("id")})
                    found = True
                    break
                if cand_name and cand_name not in seen_folders:
                    seen_folders.append(cand_name)
                if level < MAX_DEPTH:
                    _, sub = _list({"drive_id": cand.get("driveId"), "item_id": cand.get("id")})
                    search.extend((child, level + 1) for child in sub if child.get("isFolder"))
            if not found:
                # Reading everything instead would silently blend separate investments into one report.
                problem = ("No folder under " + (folder_name or "that link") + " has \"" +
                           str(params.get("investment_name") or "") + "\" in its name. The folders there are: " +
                           ", ".join(seen_folders[:12]) + ". Use one of those names, or link straight to the "
                           "investment's own folder and leave the name blank.")
                items = []
        else:
            # With no name to pick by, a link to the folder *above* several investments used to read them all
            # and blend them into one report. The figures still reconciled, because the capital account settles
            # them, so only the prose gave it away. Look for separate investments and stop when there is more
            # than one.
            search = [(i, 1) for i in items if i.get("isFolder")]
            separate = []
            opened = 0
            while search and opened < FIND_OPENS:
                cand, level = search.pop(0)
                opened += 1
                if _is_investment(cand):
                    separate.append(str(cand.get("name") or ""))
                    continue
                if level < FIND_DEPTH:
                    _, sub = _list({"drive_id": cand.get("driveId"), "item_id": cand.get("id")})
                    search.extend((child, level + 1) for child in sub if child.get("isFolder"))
            if len(separate) > 1:
                problem = ((folder_name or "That link") + " holds " + str(len(separate)) +
                           " separate investments: " + ", ".join(separate[:8]) + ". Put one of those names in "
                           "the investment name box, or link straight to that investment's own folder, so the "
                           "report covers one investment and not several blended together.")
                items = []
        queue = [(i, "", 1) for i in items]
        while queue:
            item, parent, depth = queue.pop(0)
            name = str(item.get("name") or "")
            path = (parent + "/" + name) if parent else name
            if item.get("isFolder"):
                if depth < MAX_DEPTH and len(files) < MAX_ITEMS:
                    _, sub = _list({"drive_id": item.get("driveId"), "item_id": item.get("id")})
                    queue.extend((s, path, depth + 1) for s in sub)
                continue
            f = {
                "name": name,
                "path": path,
                "folder": parent,
                "url": str(item.get("webUrl") or ""),
                "id": item.get("id"),
                "driveId": item.get("driveId"),
                "category": _category(name, parent),
                "readable": _ext(name) in READABLE,
            }
            f.update(_year(name, item.get("lastModifiedDateTime")))
            files.append(f)
    except Exception as exc:
        problem = "Couldn't open the folder: " + _err(exc)

    to_read = sorted([f for f in files if f["readable"]],
                     key=lambda f: (READ_ORDER.index(f["category"]), -(f["year"] or 0), f["name"].lower()))
    for f in to_read[:MAX_READ]:
        try:
            r = api.connectors.invoke(server=SP, tool="read_sharepoint_file",
                                      args={"drive_id": f["driveId"], "item_id": f["id"], "max_chars": MAX_TEXT})
        except Exception as exc:
            f["skipped"] = _err(exc)
            continue
        text = str(r.get("text") or "") if isinstance(r, dict) else ""
        if not text.strip():
            f["skipped"] = (str(r.get("note") or "") if isinstance(r, dict) else "") or "no text found"
            continue
        try:
            d = _clean(api.ai.extract(prompt=PROMPT, input="File: " + f["path"] + "\n\n" + text[:MAX_TEXT],
                                      schema_hint=SHAPE))
        except Exception:
            try:
                d = _clean(api.ai.extract(prompt=SLIM_PROMPT,
                                          input="File: " + f["path"] + "\n\n" + text[:SLIM_TEXT],
                                          schema_hint=SLIM_SHAPE))
                f["figures_only"] = True
            except Exception as exc:
                f["skipped"] = "AI couldn't read it (" + str(exc)[:200] + ")"
                continue
        # The AI's view of the document type beats the folder name
        if DOC_TYPES.get(d["doc_type"]):
            f["category"] = DOC_TYPES[d["doc_type"]]
        if d["doc_date"] and not f["fy"]:
            f["year"] = int(d["doc_date"][:4])
        f["read"] = True
        docs.append(dict(d, file=f["name"], url=f["url"], category=f["category"]))
    for f in to_read[MAX_READ:]:
        f["skipped"] = "over the " + str(MAX_READ) + "-file limit for one run (still counted)"
    for f in files:
        f.pop("id", None)
        f.pop("driveId", None)

    if not problem and not docs:
        problem = "No documents could be read in " + (folder_name or "the folder") + "."

slim = len([f for f in files if f.get("figures_only")])
summary = (problem + " " if problem else "") + "Found " + str(len(files)) + " file" + \
    ("" if len(files) == 1 else "s") + ", read " + str(len(docs)) + \
    ((" (" + str(slim) + " for their figures only)") if slim else "") + "."

# ── Put one investment's facts together from its documents, and have AI write the family-friendly overview ──
import json
import re
from collections import Counter

MAX_SNIPPETS = 10
# Groups whose documents describe the whole fund or company, not this holder's own money. Their figures are
# read for the story — business, milestones — but never for the amounts on the report.
FUND_LEVEL = ("Investor updates", "Due diligence")

WRITE_PROMPT = (
    "You are writing the overview on a one-page investment summary for members of a family who have no prior "
    "knowledge of this investment. Use only the facts and notes given. Write in plain, warm, factual English, "
    "Australian spelling, no jargon, no advice, no hype. business: what the company does and who its customers "
    "are (at most 50 words). overview is the opening paragraph of the report (at most 65 words): who holds "
    "what, since when, what it cost, what it has paid out and what it is worth now, as one piece of prose. "
    "Use invested_total, distributions_total and the valuation given and no other totals. "
    "investment: what the family holds, when and for how much (at most 45 words); "
    "invested_total and distributions_total are the settled figures, so write those exact words whenever you "
    "give a total, and never a figure added up from the notes, even where the notes say otherwise. "
    "rationale: why the family invested, as the notes say (at most 45 words); if the notes don't say, write what "
    "the documents show about the opportunity at the time, without guessing. Where the notes give you nothing "
    "for a field, answer with an empty string - never a sentence saying the material does not say, which is "
    "printed on the page as if it were the answer. milestones: pick the 5 most "
    "meaningful dated events from the candidates, oldest first, each at most 8 words, keeping the given dates. "
    "Answer with the JSON object only, and no explanation."
)
# The same ask with the room taken out of it, for when the first answer is cut off at the output limit.
SHORT_PROMPT = (
    "Write the overview on a one-page investment summary for a family with no prior knowledge of this "
    "investment. Use only the facts given, in plain factual English with Australian spelling, no jargon and "
    "no advice. overview (at most 50 words): who holds what, since when, what it cost, what it has paid out "
    "and what it is worth now. business (at most 35 words): what the company does. investment (at most 30 "
    "words): what the family holds and when. rationale (at most 30 words): why they invested. Answer with an "
    "empty string for anything the facts do not give you, never a sentence saying so. Quote "
    "invested_total and distributions_total exactly as given and never a total of your own. "
    "Answer with the JSON object only, and no explanation."
)
SHORT_SHAPE = '{"overview": str, "business": str, "investment": str, "rationale": str}'
WRITE_SHAPE = '{"overview": str, "business": str, "investment": str, "rationale": str, "milestones": [{"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "text": str}]}'


def _common(values):
    vals = [v for v in values if v]
    return Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0] if vals else ""


def _latest(docs, key):
    """The value from the most recent document that states it."""
    best = None
    for d in docs:
        if d.get(key) not in (None, "", "unknown") and (best is None or (d.get("doc_date") or "") >= (best.get("doc_date") or "")):
            best = d
    return best.get(key) if best else None


# Words too common to tell two events apart.
MSTOP = ("a", "an", "and", "at", "by", "for", "from", "in", "of", "on", "the", "to", "with")


def _stem(w):
    """Enough of a stem that "closing" and "close" meet; not enough that "sold" and "sale" do."""
    if len(w) > 4 and w.endswith("ing"):
        w = w[:-3]
    elif len(w) > 3 and w.endswith("ed"):
        w = w[:-2]
    elif len(w) > 3 and w.endswith("s"):
        w = w[:-1]
    return w[:-1] if len(w) > 3 and w.endswith("e") else w


def _mkey(date, text):
    """One key per event. Two documents tell the same one in different words - the 06-Nov report carried
    both "First closing of the fund" and "First Close of the Fund" under key dates - and comparing the
    opening letters kept them apart, so compare the month and the significant words instead."""
    words = sorted({_stem(w) for w in re.findall(r"[a-z]+", str(text).lower()) if w not in MSTOP})
    return date[:7] + " ".join(words)


def _keep(seen, key, m):
    """Of two tellings of one event, keep the fuller."""
    if len(str(m.get("text") or "")) > len(str((seen.get(key) or {}).get("text") or "")):
        seen[key] = m


def _named_date(name, said):
    """The date in the file name, which is the same on every run, in place of the one the model read out
    of the document, which is not: one capital call came back as 2020-11-09, 2020-09-02 and 2020-09-11 on
    three runs of the same folder, moving the first investment date, the holding period and the IRR."""
    m = re.search(r"(19|20)(\d{2})[ ._-]?(\d{2})(?:[ ._-]?(\d{2}))?(?!\d)", str(name or ""))
    if not m:
        return said
    year, month, day = m.group(1) + m.group(2), m.group(3), m.group(4)
    if not "01" <= month <= "12":
        return said
    if day and "01" <= day <= "31":
        return year + "-" + month + "-" + day
    # The name gives the month only. Keep the day the model read when it falls inside that month.
    return said if str(said)[:7] == year + "-" + month else year + "-" + month + "-01"


def _aud(n):
    """A$500,000 for a whole number of dollars, A$500,000.50 otherwise — what the report itself shows."""
    return "A$" + format(n, ",.0f" if abs(n - round(n)) < 0.005 else ",.2f")


def _own_money(d):
    """True when the amounts in this document are the holder's own, not the whole fund's."""
    return d.get("scope") != "fund" and d.get("category") not in FUND_LEVEL


docs = params.get("docs") or []
unwritten = ""
files = params.get("files") or []
problem = str(params.get("problem") or "")
facts = {}

if docs and not problem:
    company = _common(d.get("company") for d in docs) or str(params.get("investment_name") or "") or \
        str(params.get("folder_name") or "")

    mine = [d for d in docs if _own_money(d)]

    # Money invested: each subscription or purchase once, even when several documents mention it
    tranches = {}
    for d in mine:
        t = d.get("new_investment")
        if t:
            t = dict(t, date=_named_date(d.get("file"), t["date"]))
            tranches.setdefault((t["date"], round(t["amount"])), t)
    tranches = sorted(tranches.values(), key=lambda t: t["date"])

    # Dividends: each payment once, from the dividend statements
    paid = {}
    for d in mine:
        for x in d.get("dividends") or []:
            paid.setdefault((x["date"], round(x["amount"], 2)), x)
    dividends = sorted(paid.values(), key=lambda x: x["date"])
    # Year totals (tax statements) fill in years with no individual statements
    year_totals = {}
    for d in mine:
        for y in d.get("dividend_year_totals") or []:
            year_totals[y["year_ending"]] = y["amount"]

    valuations = sorted([d["valuation"] for d in mine if d.get("valuation")], key=lambda v: v["date"])

    # A capital account or wealth statement is the manager's own record of this holder's position, so it
    # settles the totals. The call notices still supply the dates the money moved, for the IRR.
    accounts = sorted([d["capital_account"] for d in mine if d.get("capital_account")], key=lambda a: a["as_at"])
    account = accounts[-1] if accounts else None
    if account:
        paid_in = account.get("contributions")
        called = round(sum(t["amount"] for t in tranches), 2)
        if paid_in and called and abs(called - paid_in) > 1:
            factor = paid_in / called
            tranches = [dict(t, amount=round(t["amount"] * factor, 2)) for t in tranches]
            drift = round(paid_in - sum(t["amount"] for t in tranches), 2)
            if drift:
                tranches[-1] = dict(tranches[-1], amount=round(tranches[-1]["amount"] + drift, 2))
        # The statement's inception-to-date distributions settle the money paid out, whether the documents add up
        # to less (a statement nobody filed) or to more (a refunded call, or a fund-wide payment read as this
        # holder's). Anything paid after the statement date is outside it, so it stands on its own.
        out = account.get("distributions")
        as_at = account["as_at"]
        if out is not None:
            on_record = round(sum(x["amount"] for x in dividends if x["date"] <= as_at) +
                              sum(v for k, v in year_totals.items() if k <= as_at), 2)
            if abs(on_record - out) > max(1.0, out * 0.05):
                dividends = [x for x in dividends if x["date"] > as_at]
                year_totals = {k: v for k, v in year_totals.items() if k > as_at}
                if out:
                    year_totals[as_at] = out
        if account.get("nav") is not None and (not valuations or valuations[-1]["date"] <= account["as_at"]):
            valuations.append({"date": account["as_at"], "amount": account["nav"],
                               "basis": "capital account statement"})

    milestones = {}
    for d in docs:
        for m in d.get("milestones") or []:
            _keep(milestones, _mkey(m["date"], m["text"]), m)
    # The investment and the first dividend, unless a document already marks that month
    months = {m["date"][:7] for m in milestones.values()}
    if tranches and tranches[0]["date"][:7] not in months:
        milestones["inv"] = {"date": tranches[0]["date"], "text": "Investment made"}
    if dividends and dividends[0]["date"][:7] not in months:
        milestones["div1"] = {"date": dividends[0]["date"], "text": "First dividend paid"}
    candidates = sorted(milestones.values(), key=lambda m: m["date"])[:40]

    def snippets(key):
        seen = []
        for d in sorted(docs, key=lambda d: d.get("doc_date") or "", reverse=True):
            s = d.get(key)
            if s and s not in seen:
                seen.append(s)
        return seen[:MAX_SNIPPETS]

    facts = {
        "company": company,
        "holder": _common(d.get("holder") for d in docs),
        "instrument": _latest(docs, "instrument") or "",
        "shares": _latest(docs, "shares"),
        "price_per_share": _common(d.get("price_per_share") for d in docs if d.get("price_per_share")) or None,
        "ownership_pct": _latest(docs, "ownership_pct"),
        "website": _common(d.get("website") for d in docs),
        "board": _latest(docs, "board") or "",
        "asset_type": _latest(docs, "asset_type") or "",
        "tax_status": _latest(docs, "tax_status") or "",
        "liquidity": _latest(docs, "liquidity") or "",
        "status": _latest(docs, "status") or "",
        "tranches": tranches,
        "dividends": dividends,
        "year_totals": year_totals,
        "capital_account": account,
        "valuation": valuations[-1] if valuations else None,
        "milestones": candidates[:5],
        "sector": _latest(docs, "sector") or "",
        "overview": "",
        "business": "",
        "investment": "",
        "rationale": "",
    }

    brief = {k: facts[k] for k in ("company", "holder", "instrument", "shares", "ownership_pct", "tranches",
                                   "valuation", "status", "website")}
    paid_out = round(sum(x["amount"] for x in dividends) + sum(year_totals.values()), 2)
    brief["dividends_received"] = {"payments": len(dividends), "total": paid_out}
    brief["invested_total"] = _aud(round(sum(t["amount"] for t in tranches), 2))
    brief["distributions_total"] = _aud(paid_out)
    brief["notes_on_business"] = snippets("business")
    brief["notes_on_investment"] = snippets("investment")
    brief["notes_on_rationale"] = snippets("rationale")
    brief["milestone_candidates"] = candidates
    # A silent fallback here cost the 05-Nov run its executive summary: the call was cut off at the output
    # limit, the exception was swallowed, and the report went out with raw document snippets in its place.
    try:
        w = api.ai.extract(prompt=WRITE_PROMPT, input=json.dumps(brief)[:28000], schema_hint=WRITE_SHAPE)
    except Exception as exc:
        unwritten = str(exc)[:120]
        bare = {k: brief[k] for k in ("company", "holder", "instrument", "tranches", "valuation",
                                      "invested_total", "distributions_total")}
        try:
            w = api.ai.extract(prompt=SHORT_PROMPT, input=json.dumps(bare)[:8000], schema_hint=SHORT_SHAPE)
            unwritten = ""
        except Exception:
            w = {}
    w = w if isinstance(w, dict) else {}
    for k in ("overview", "business", "investment", "rationale"):
        facts[k] = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(w.get(k) or "")).strip() or (snippets(k)[:1] or [""])[0]
    picked = [m for m in (w.get("milestones") or [])
              if isinstance(m, dict) and re.match(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", str(m.get("date") or "")) and m.get("text")]
    if picked:
        kept = {}
        for m in sorted(picked, key=lambda m: m["date"]):
            _keep(kept, _mkey(m["date"], str(m["text"])), {"date": m["date"], "text": str(m["text"])[:60]})
        facts["milestones"] = sorted(kept.values(), key=lambda m: m["date"])[:5]

acct = facts.get("capital_account") or {}
if unwritten:
    problem = ("The report was written straight from the documents: AI couldn't put the overview into words (" +
               unwritten + "). The figures are unaffected; the wording is worth a read before sharing.")
summary = problem or ("Put together " + (facts.get("company") or "the investment") + " from " + str(len(docs)) +
                      " documents: " + str(len(facts.get("dividends") or [])) + " dividend payments, " +
                      str(len(facts.get("tranches") or [])) + " investment(s)" +
                      (", totals taken from the capital account statement at " + acct["as_at"] if acct else "") + ".")

# ── Draw the one-page investment summary PDF, save it to Knowledge and email it ──
import base64
import hashlib
import re
from datetime import date
from typing import Any

from fpdf import FPDF

MAIL = "m365-mail-send"
FOLDER = "Investments/Reports"
DEFAULT_TO = "sean.baker@mysmb.com"
CURRENCY = "Australian dollars (A$)"
MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]

NAVY = (22, 37, 64)
GOLD = (176, 141, 87)
TEAL = (70, 130, 112)
INK = (33, 37, 41)
GREY = (110, 114, 120)
LINE = (222, 220, 214)
PAPER = (244, 242, 237)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)


# -- Formatting --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def d_fmt(iso):
    """dd-Mmm-yy"""
    if not iso:
        return ""
    y, m, d = iso[:10].split("-")
    return d + "-" + MONTHS[int(m) - 1] + "-" + y[2:]


def m_fmt(iso):
    """Mmm yyyy, for milestones"""
    return MONTHS[int(iso[5:7]) - 1] + " " + iso[:4] if iso else ""


def money(n, dp=0):
    return ("-" if n < 0 else "") + "A$" + format(abs(n), ",." + str(dp) + "f")


def short(n):
    """A$250k / A$1.2m"""
    a = abs(n)
    s = ("%.1fm" % (a / 1e6)).replace(".0m", "m") if a >= 1e6 else ("%.1fk" % (a / 1e3)).replace(".0k", "k")
    return ("-" if n < 0 else "") + "A$" + s


def fy(iso):
    return int(iso[:4]) + (1 if int(iso[5:7]) >= 7 else 0)


def held(start, end):
    if not start or not end:
        return ""
    months = (int(end[:4]) - int(start[:4])) * 12 + int(end[5:7]) - int(start[5:7])
    if int(end[8:10]) < int(start[8:10]):
        months -= 1
    y, m = divmod(max(months, 0), 12)
    return (str(y) + " yr" + ("s" if y != 1 else "") + " " if y else "") + str(m) + " mth" + ("s" if m != 1 else "")


def safe(s):
    """Core PDF fonts are Latin-1 only."""
    s = str(s or "")
    for a, b in (("–", "-"), ("—", "-"), ("‘", "'"), ("’", "'"), ("“", '"'), ("”", '"'), ("•", "-"),
                 ("…", "..."), ("→", "->"), ("≈", "~"), (" ", " ")):
        s = s.replace(a, b)
    return s.encode("latin-1", "ignore").decode("latin-1")


def npv(rate, pts):
    return sum(a / (1 + rate) ** t for t, a in pts)


def xirr(flows):
    """Annualised return for dated cash flows [(iso, amount)], or None."""
    if len(flows) < 2 or not any(a < 0 for _, a in flows) or not any(a > 0 for _, a in flows):
        return None
    t0 = date.fromisoformat(min(d for d, _ in flows))
    pts = [((date.fromisoformat(d) - t0).days / 365.0, a) for d, a in flows]
    lo, hi = -0.99, 10.0
    if npv(lo, pts) * npv(hi, pts) > 0:
        return None
    for _ in range(200):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        if npv(lo, pts) * npv(mid, pts) <= 0:
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid
    return (lo + hi) / 2


# -- Inputs ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

facts = params.get("facts") or {}
files = params.get("files") or []
xero = params.get("xero") or {}
problem = str(params.get("problem") or "")
folder_name = str(params.get("folder_name") or "")
folder_url = str(params.get("folder_url") or "")
to = [a.strip() for a in re.split(r"[,;\s]+", str(params.get("email_to") or DEFAULT_TO)) if "@" in a]
brand = str(params.get("family_name") or "").strip()
report_file = ""
emailed_to = ""
sent = ""
filed = ""
report_link = ""

if problem or not facts:
    summary = problem or "Nothing to report."
else:
    today = date.today().isoformat()
    company = facts.get("company") or folder_name or "Investment"
    # "Greenfield Cold Chain Pty Ltd" -> "Greenfield Cold Chain" for the heading
    title = re.sub(r"[\s,]+\(?\s*(pty\.?\s*ltd\.?|pty\.?\s*limited|limited|ltd\.?|inc\.?|l\.?p\.?|llc)\)?\s*$",
                   "", company, flags=re.I) or company
    holder = facts.get("holder") or ""
    brand = brand or " ".join(holder.split()[:2]) or "Investment summary"
    tranches = facts.get("tranches") or []
    invested = round(sum(t["amount"] for t in tranches), 2)
    start = tranches[0]["date"] if tranches else ""

    dividends = list(facts.get("dividends") or [])
    div_source = "the dividend statements"
    if not dividends and xero.get("receipts"):
        dividends = [{"date": r["date"], "amount": r["amount"], "franked_pct": None} for r in xero["receipts"]]
        div_source = "Xero bank receipts"
    by_fy = {}
    for x in dividends:
        by_fy[fy(x["date"])] = by_fy.get(fy(x["date"]), 0) + x["amount"]
    # Years with only a yearly total (tax statements, reports): counted at the year's end date
    year_flows = []
    for ye, amt in sorted((facts.get("year_totals") or {}).items()):
        if fy(ye) not in by_fy and amt:
            by_fy[fy(ye)] = amt
            year_flows.append((ye, amt))
    if year_flows:
        div_source = (div_source + " and the yearly totals in the documents") if dividends else \
            "the yearly totals stated in the documents"
    div_text = (str(len(dividends)) + " payment" + ("s" if len(dividends) != 1 else "")) if dividends else \
        (str(len(year_flows)) + " financial year" + ("s" if len(year_flows) != 1 else "")) if year_flows else ""
    div_total = round(sum(by_fy.values()), 2)
    franks = [float(x["franked_pct"]) for x in dividends if x.get("franked_pct") is not None]
    franking = ("fully franked" if franks and all(f >= 99.5 for f in franks) else
                "unfranked" if franks and all(f <= 0.5 for f in franks) else "partly franked" if franks else "")

    val = facts.get("valuation") or {}
    value = val.get("amount")
    report_date = val.get("date") or today
    total_value = (value or 0) + div_total
    moic = total_value / invested if invested and value is not None else None
    flows = [(t["date"], -t["amount"]) for t in tranches] + [(x["date"], x["amount"]) for x in dividends] + year_flows
    if value is not None and val.get("date"):
        flows.append((val["date"], value))
    irr = xirr(flows) if value is not None and invested else None

    status = (facts.get("status") or "active").upper()
    if status == "UNKNOWN":
        status = "ACTIVE"
    initials = "".join(w[0] for w in brand.split()[:3]).upper() or "INV"
    ref = initials + "-INV-" + today[:4] + "-" + str(int(hashlib.sha256(company.encode()).hexdigest(), 16) % 1000).zfill(3)
    meta = [("Reporting date", d_fmt(report_date)), ("Prepared", d_fmt(today)),
            ("Investor entity", holder), ("Currency", CURRENCY)]

    # -- Drawing helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    pdf = FPDF(format="A4", unit="mm")
    pdf.set_auto_page_break(False)
    pdf.set_margins(0, 0, 0)
    pdf.add_page()
    pdf.c_margin = 0
    W = 210
    L = 10
    CW = W - 2 * L

    def font(size, style: Any = "", face="Helvetica", color=INK):
        pdf.set_font(face, style, size)
        pdf.set_text_color(*color)

    def box(x, y, w, h, fill=WHITE, border=LINE):
        pdf.set_fill_color(*fill)
        pdf.set_draw_color(*border)
        pdf.set_line_width(0.2)
        pdf.rect(x, y, w, h, style="DF")

    def label(x, y, text, color=GREY, size=6.5):
        font(size, "B", color=color)
        pdf.set_char_spacing(0.6)
        pdf.text(x, y, safe(text.upper()))
        pdf.set_char_spacing(0)

    def write(x, y, w, text, size=7.5, lh=3.4, color=INK, style="", max_lines=None, align="L"):
        font(size, style, color=color)
        pdf.set_xy(x, y)
        lines = pdf.multi_cell(w, lh, safe(text), align=align, dry_run=True, output="LINES")
        if max_lines and len(lines) > max_lines:
            lines = lines[:max_lines]
            lines[-1] = lines[-1].rstrip(" .,;") + "..."
        for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
            pdf.set_xy(x, y + i * lh)
            pdf.cell(w, lh, ln, align=align)
        return y + len(lines) * lh

    def fit(text, w, size, style: Any = ""):
        pdf.set_font(pdf.font_family, style, size)
        t = safe(text)
        if pdf.get_string_width(t) <= w:
            return t
        while t and pdf.get_string_width(t + "...") > w:
            t = t[:-1]
        return t.rstrip() + "..."

    # -- Page --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # The arrangement of the Option A tear sheet as the family marked it up: a white masthead over a navy
    # rule, the four-cell band, key terms down the left, the written summary and the numbers on the right,
    # the two charts beneath, and the reference number in the page footer.
    SW = 56                 # key-terms sidebar
    RX = L + SW + 6         # right column
    RW = CW - SW - 6
    CHART_Y = 193
    FOOT_Y = 253

    def band(x, y, w, text, note=""):
        """A navy section heading with a rule under it, and an optional note in brackets beside it."""
        font(7, "B", color=NAVY)
        pdf.set_char_spacing(0.8)
        pdf.text(x, y, safe(text.upper()))
        used = pdf.get_string_width(safe(text.upper())) + 0.8 * 0.353 * len(text)
        pdf.set_char_spacing(0)
        if note:
            font(6, color=GREY)
            pdf.text(x + used + 2.5, y, safe(note))
        pdf.set_draw_color(*NAVY)
        pdf.set_line_width(0.4)
        pdf.line(x, y + 1.9, x + w, y + 1.9)
        pdf.set_line_width(0.2)
        return y + 7.0

    def rule(x, y, w):
        pdf.set_draw_color(*LINE)
        pdf.line(x, y, x + w, y)

    def num(n):
        return format(n, ",.0f") if n is not None else "-"

    pdf.set_fill_color(*WHITE)
    pdf.rect(0, 0, W, 297, style="F")

    # -- Masthead
    font(15, "B", color=NAVY)
    pdf.set_char_spacing(2.0)
    pdf.text(L, 18, safe(brand.upper()))
    pdf.set_char_spacing(0)
    # "Future Now" as the name on the report and "Future Now Investments Pty Ltd" as the entity: the rest of
    # the entity's name sits under the brand, the way the template's lockup does.
    tail = holder[len(brand):].strip(" ,") if holder.lower().startswith(brand.lower()) and \
        len(holder) > len(brand) else ""
    if tail:
        font(6, "B", color=GREY)
        pdf.set_char_spacing(1.0)
        pdf.text(L, 22, safe(tail.upper()))
        pdf.set_char_spacing(0)
    for ty, txt, col, sz in [(18, "INVESTMENT SUMMARY", NAVY, 7), (21.5, "PRIVATE & CONFIDENTIAL", GREY, 6)]:

                "subject": "Investment summary: " + company + " (" + d_fmt(today) + ")",
                "body": body,
                "attachments": [{"name": clean + " Investment Summary.pdf", "contentBase64": base64.b64encode(data).decode(),
                                 "contentType": "application/pdf"}],
            })
            emailed_to = ", ".join(to)
            sent = " and emailed it to " + emailed_to
        except Exception as exc:
            msg = str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:200]
            sent = ", but couldn't email it (" + msg + ")"

    summary = "Saved " + report_file + filed + sent + "."
